text: Hello children, nice to see you again.I'm your teacher, Hena.Please prepare your stationery.It's time for English class.Let's review the sound.You, you, pupil.You, you, tube.Have a try.Nice try.Look, who's she?She's Judy.Let's listen and follow.Judy is a pupil.She has some tubes.Good.Boys and girls, we know Kitty and Alice were in the park.They have a rhyme for the park.Let's try to read it.Nice reading.Now, let's check the homework on workbook, page 50, part A, listen and match.Look at the boat.It's blue.How about the others?Please choose and say.Bingo.Look at picture 2.This time you ask, I answer.It's green.Oh, that's right.You can play the memory game with your classmates.Oh, look.Are your answers right?Yes, you have a good memory.It is a fine day today.Kitty and Alice are in the park.Let's listen and feel.What can they see?And what color are the things?What color is it?It's red.I have a kite.It's orange.Look at this flower.It's yellow.Yes, they can see a boat.Can you spell it?Good job.Yes, it's red.What else can they see?Yes, they can see a kite.How to spell kite?The kite is orange.They can also see a flower.Let's spell together.F, L, O, W, E, R, flower.The flower is yellow.This time, please open your book.Turn to page 34.Excellent.Please look and read.This time, let's look and say.This time, let's enjoy a color song.Yellow, green and red and blue.Red and blue, red and blue.I love colors.How about you?Wow, what a nice song.Kitty and Alice have a picture.They want to color it.Look.They have some colors.They are red, yellow, blue and white.Let's mix the colors.Follow me.Mix the colors.I have two colors.White and red.I mix white and red.It's pink.Wow, magic.Mix white and red.Can you read it?They have pink now.Now, I can color the flower pink.Now, let's ask and answer.I am Kitty.You are Alice.Look at the flower.Let's exchange.Now, let's go on coloring.I like orange.Let's color the boat orange.But no orange here.How to mix?Please think and guess.Hmm, maybe.Kitty can mix the colors.Let's have a look.Mix red and yellow.Let's read it.Now, Kitty can color the boat orange.So nice.Do you want to have a try?Please open your book.Let's play a game.Color and write.I can write down two colors.One, mix white and red.Two, mix red and yellow.You can mix the colors color and write after class.This time, please open your workbook.Part C.Listen and color.Please prepare your crayons.Now, let's listen and color.One, look at the kite.Two, look at the flower.Three, look at the balloon.Look at the balloon.Four, look at the tree.Five, look at the boat.Time's up.Let's check.Look at the kite.Yes, it's orange.The balloon is yellow.The tree is green.And the boat is blue.Now, let's ask and answer about the picture of part C.Please ask and answer with your classmates.Thank you.Well done.Today, Kitty and Alice see some colorful things in the park.The green tree, the red kite, and the blue boat.The park is so colorful.After class, one, listen and read.Page 34 of your student's book.Look and say.Two, mix the colors, color and write.Play a game.So much for today.Class is over.See you.
